# Fixture provenance

Most layouts the tests use are written by the helpers in `tests/support/mod.rs` and follow the layout read from the solver source: they are synthetic. The `v2512-real-*` files in this folder are real. The three `v2512-real-` files of the cavity were written by the solver of the ESI v2512 line in the pinned image (digest `sha256:33fb575aa9980d2bc42fd58c75ae698c489293ba30c991380fe3f899c622f319`) on 2026-11-02, from the cavity run whose runner was killed and restarted part-way. The others (cylinder, heated cavity, turbulent step) were written in the same image on 2026-11-04 by sixty-iteration smoke runs on the compute host. All are whole and unchanged: no host name, process id or path is in them. `tests/real_file_tests.rs` reads them, and the bench crates' `tests/real_files_tests.rs` read them by relative path.

| Layout | Made by | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Probes file: `# Probe <i> (<x> <y> <z>)` headers, an index line, a `# Time` line, then rows of a time and one value or `(x y z)` vector per probe | `probes_text` | synthetic |
| Probes file of one probe, 5000 rows (`v2512-real-probe_4-U.dat`): the header `# Probe 0 (0.025 0.075 0.025)`, a `# Time` line with the index, then a time and `(Ux Uy Uz)` per row. Each probe of the cavity is its own function object and its own file. | the solver | real |
| Surface field value file: `# Region type`, `# Faces`, `# Area`, `# Scale factor`, a `# Time` line naming the columns, then tab separated rows | `surface_text` | synthetic |
| Surface field value file (`v2512-real-surfaceFieldValue-movingWall.dat`): the same five header lines, one column `sum(phi)`, 5000 rows, every value exactly zero (a closed cavity) | the solver | real |
| Sampled line, plain numeric rows: coordinate columns first, then the field components, no header | `xy_text` | synthetic |
| Sampled line of the built-in centre lines (`v2512-real-centreline-vertical_U.xy`): written with `axis y`, so four columns per row, the coordinate along the line and then Ux Uy Uz, 64 rows, no header | the solver | real |
| Force coefficient file (`v2512-real-cylinder-coefficient.dat`): eleven header lines (`# Force and moment coefficients`, `dragDir`, `sideDir`, `liftDir`, `rollAxis`, `pitchAxis`, `yawAxis`, `magUInf`, `lRef`, `Aref`, `CofR`), a bare `#` line, a `# Time` line naming twelve columns (`Cd`, `Cd(f)`, `Cd(r)`, `Cl`, `Cl(f)`, `Cl(r)`, `CmPitch`, `CmRoll`, `CmYaw`, `Cs`, `Cs(f)`, `Cs(r)`), then tab separated rows. The `liftDir` line reads `# liftDir           : (0.000000000000e+00 1.000000000000e+00 0.000000000000e+00)`. 60 rows. | the solver | real |
| Pressure probe on a patch (`v2512-real-cylinder-probe_1-p.dat`, `probe_2`): `# Probe 0 (x y z) at patch obstacle with a distance of 0 m to the original point (x y z)`, a `# Time` line with the index, then a time and one scalar per row. 60 rows each. | the solver | real |
| Heat-flux surface file (`v2512-real-heated-hot-gradT.dat`, `cold`): the same five header lines as a flux file, one column `areaIntegrate(gradT)`, and a vector `(x y z)` per row. 60 rows each; the x component is negative on every row of both walls. | the solver | real |
| Sampled lines written with `axis xyz` (`v2512-real-heated-line_1-U.xy`, `line_2`, and `v2512-real-step-line_1-U.xy` to `line_5`): six columns, the point then Ux Uy Uz, no header. 201 rows for the cavity, 1000 for the step floor, 400 for each step profile. | the solver | real |

The writer's own line monitors use `axis xyz`: three coordinate columns and then the components, six columns for a velocity. The layout is now recorded from real runs (the last row above).
